meta.description: CLI-It Hub — Agent-native stateful CLI interfaces for real software. Harness registry consumed by the `cli-it` package manager.

clis.name: demoapp
clis.description: Exemplar CLI-It harness: JSON project files, locked sessions, undo/redo, real-process export — the reference implementation of the harness pattern.

clis.name: buhocleaner
clis.description: Harness for the BuhoCleaner macOS app: read-only cleanup scans, undoable cleanup plans, live preference toggles, Sparkle update check, and safe hand-off to the real app for actual cleaning (the harness never deletes files).
clis.requires: macOS with BuhoCleaner installed (probe/plan commands work without it)
